title: 'I'm not ashamed' - Ellison on mental health and playing at 47
summary: Kevin Ellison, a 47-year-old striker who previously played for Premier League club Leicester City, discusses the importance of addressing mental health stigma in professional football. His continued career at an advanced age challenges conventional expectations about athlete longevity.
content: Striker Kevin Ellison, who once signed for Premier League Leicester City, opens up about playing at 47 - and why it's important to talk about mental health.

zh.title: "我不感到羞耻"——埃利森谈论心理健康与47岁的职业生涯
zh.summary: 现年47岁的前锋凯文·埃利森曾效力英超莱斯特城，他讨论了在职业足球中消除心理健康污名的重要性。他在高龄继续职业生涯挑战了人们对运动员职业寿命的传统预期。

title: Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes
summary: BBC Football offers daily quiz challenges including Who Am I?, Five in Five, and Brainteaser segments to test football enthusiasts' knowledge. These interactive features engage fans through trivia and brain teasers.
content: Test your ball knowledge with today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

zh.title: 通过我们的日常测验展示你的足球知识
zh.summary: BBC足球频道提供日常测验挑战，包括"我是谁?"、"五选五"和"脑筋急转弯"等环节，用来测试足球爱好者的知识。这些互动功能通过琐事问答和脑筋急转弯来吸引球迷。

title: Second set of twins a good distraction from injury - Maddison
summary: Tottenham midfielder James Maddison credits his five young children, including two sets of twins, with keeping him mentally occupied during his ACL injury recovery last season. The distraction from his large family under age five provided crucial support during his rehabilitation.
content: Tottenham midfielder James Maddison says having five children aged four and under - including a second set of twins - helpfully distracted him from his ACL injury last season.

zh.title: 第二对双胞胎是伤病期间的好分散注意力——马迪森
zh.summary: 托特纳姆热刺中场球员詹姆斯·马迪森表示，他的五个年幼孩子，包括两对双胞胎，在他上赛季前十字韧带伤病恢复期间让他精神上得到了寄托。这个由五岁以下孩子组成的大家庭在他康复期间提供了至关重要的支持。

title: My family got me through injury - Maddison
summary: James Maddison reflects on how his five young children and new manager Roberto de Zerbi's leadership helped him navigate a long-term ACL injury. The combination of family responsibilities and fresh tactical direction provided emotional stability during his recovery.
content: Tottenham midfielder James Maddison discusses life under boss Roberto de Zerbi and how the distraction of having five children under five at home kept him busy while he was out with a long-term injury.

zh.title: 我的家人帮我度过了伤病难关 - 麦迪逊
zh.summary: 詹姆斯·麦迪逊反思了他的五个年幼孩子和新主教练罗伯托·德·泽比的领导如何帮助他度过长期前十字韧带损伤。家庭责任和新的战术方向的结合在他恢复期间提供了情感稳定。
